recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **7 cans** of tuna (drained) ([**0:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=46s))
- **1** yellow onion (roughly chopped) ([**0:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=6s))
- **1 bushel** of green onions (chopped) ([**1:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=90s))
- **5 cloves** of garlic (freshly pressed) ([**2:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=135s)) [[1](https://youtu.be/91k3XnJaFz8#:~:text=Learn%20to%20master%20a%20tuna%20croquettes%20recipe,mix%2C%20and%20pan%2Dfry%20the%20perfect%20patties%20today.)]
recipe-section-1.html:
• 7 cans of tuna (drained) (0:46)

  • 5 cloves of garlic (freshly pressed) (2:15) [1]
recipe-section-1.title: The Base & Aromatics

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **7** whole eggs ([**6:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=382s))
- **30 g** all-purpose flour ([**2:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=175s))
- **50 g** panko breadcrumbs ([**3:02**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=182s))
- **44.5 mL** chili spice blend of choice (Macedonian chili spice used in the video) ([**4:02**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=242s))
- **29.5 mL** Creole seasoning ([**4:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=251s))
- **29.5 mL** "Slap Ya Mama" seasoning ([**4:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=251s))
- **29.5 mL** Everything But the Bagel seasoning ([**4:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=276s))
- **29.5 mL** onion powder ([**4:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=285s))
- **22 mL** garlic powder ([**4:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=265s))
- **10 mL** salt ([**4:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=297s))
- Cooking oil for frying (such as avocado oil or olive oil) ([**8:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=497s)) [[1](https://youtu.be/91k3XnJaFz8#:~:text=Learn%20to%20master%20a%20tuna%20croquettes%20recipe,mix%2C%20and%20pan%2Dfry%20the%20perfect%20patties%20today.)]
recipe-section-2.html:
• 7 whole eggs (6:22)
  • 30 g all-purpose flour (2:55)

  • 44.5 mL chili spice blend of choice (Macedonian chili spice used in the video) (4:02)
  • 29.5 mL Creole seasoning (4:11)
  • 29.5 mL "Slap Ya Mama" seasoning (4:11)
  • 29.5 mL Everything But the Bagel seasoning (4:36)
  • 29.5 mL onion powder (4:45)
  • 22 mL garlic powder (4:25)
  • 10 mL salt (4:57)

recipe-section-2.title: Binders & Seasonings

recipe-section-3.markdown:
*Divided equally into two portions—one half for the wet batter bowl and one half for the dry flour bowl.*

- **Slap Ya Mama Cajun seasoning**: 29.5 mL
- **Creole seasoning**: 29.5 mL
- **Lemon pepper seasoning** (such as Smoke and Fire brand): 10 mL
- **Garlic powder**: 10 mL
- **Crushed red pepper flakes**: 10 mL
- **Tajín seasoning**: 10 mL
- **Sazón packet** (Seafood style or traditional): 1 packet
- **Chicken bouillon cube**: 1 cube (crushed completely and reserved specifically for the dry batter mix)
- **Sea salt**: 10 mL (use selectively; most pre-blended spices carry heavy sodium properties)

recipe-section-5.markdown:
1. Roughly chop your yellow onion and the bushel of green onions ([**0:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=6s)).
2. Place the drained canned tuna into a large mixing bowl, and add the chopped onions ([**0:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=46s)).
3. Use a garlic press to crush 5 cloves of fresh garlic directly into the bowl ([**2:15**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=135s)).
recipe-section-5.html:
1. Roughly chop your yellow onion and the bushel of green onions (0:06).
  2. Place the drained canned tuna into a large mixing bowl, and add the chopped onions (0:46).
  3. Use a garlic press to crush 5 cloves of fresh garlic directly into the bowl (2:15).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 1: Chop the Aromatics

recipe-section-6.markdown:
1. Place the bowl on a kitchen scale ([**2:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=148s)). Add **30 g of flour** and **50 g of panko breadcrumbs** ([**2:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=175s)). *(Tip: Aaron originally meant to only use panko, but accidentally added flour—you can omit the flour if you prefer a lighter binder!)* ([**3:02**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=182s)).
2. Crack **4 whole eggs** into the mixture to start ([**3:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=211s)).
3. Add all of your spices: chili spice, Creole seasoning, "Slap Ya Mama", garlic powder, Everything But the Bagel seasoning, onion powder, and salt ([**3:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=236s)).
recipe-section-6.html:
1. Place the bowl on a kitchen scale (2:28). Add 30 g of flour and 50 g of panko breadcrumbs (2:55). (Tip: Aaron originally meant to only use panko, but accidentally added flour—you can omit the flour if you prefer a lighter binder!) (3:02).
  2. Crack 4 whole eggs into the mixture to start (3:31).
  3. Add all of your spices: chili spice, Creole seasoning, "Slap Ya Mama", garlic powder, Everything But the Bagel seasoning, onion powder, and salt (3:56).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 2: Add Binders & Seasoning

recipe-section-7.markdown:
1. Put on a pair of kitchen gloves and use your hands to thoroughly mix and scrunch everything together—similar to mixing a meatloaf ([**5:10**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=310s)).
2. Because 7 cans of tuna make a massive batch, the mixture might look too dry ([**5:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=344s)). If needed, add **3 more whole eggs** (bringing the total to 7 eggs) to get a wet but shapeable consistency ([**5:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=344s)).
3. Line a large plate with parchment paper ([**5:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=319s)). Scoop up the mixture and shape them into generous, large hamburger-sized patties ([**5:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=344s)).
recipe-section-7.html:
1. Put on a pair of kitchen gloves and use your hands to thoroughly mix and scrunch everything together—similar to mixing a meatloaf (5:10).
  2. Because 7 cans of tuna make a massive batch, the mixture might look too dry (5:44). If needed, add 3 more whole eggs (bringing the total to 7 eggs) to get a wet but shapeable consistency (5:44).
  3. Line a large plate with parchment paper (5:19). Scoop up the mixture and shape them into generous, large hamburger-sized patties (5:44).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 3: Mix and Shape the Patties
recipe-section-7.heading_html: Step 3: Mix and Shape the Patties

recipe-section-8.markdown:
1. Because this recipe makes a lot of leftovers, heat up **two skillets** at the same time to speed up the process ([**7:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=431s)).
2. Add a generous layer of avocado oil or olive oil to the bottom of the pans for a shallow fry ([**8:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=497s)). Set the stoves to **low-medium heat** ([**8:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=486s)).
3. Once the oil is hot, carefully drop the patties into the pans ([**8:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=520s)).
4. Since canned tuna is already cooked, you are just looking for texture ([**8:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=532s)). Fry each side until a deep, beautiful, crunchy golden crust forms ([**9:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=574s)).
5. Remove from the pans and serve warm! Aaron suggests pairing these savory, salty croquettes with something smooth and creamy, like mashed potatoes ([**10:45**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=91k3XnJaFz8&t=645s)).
recipe-section-8.html:
1. Because this recipe makes a lot of leftovers, heat up two skillets at the same time to speed up the process (7:11).
  2. Add a generous layer of avocado oil or olive oil to the bottom of the pans for a shallow fry (8:17). Set the stoves to low-medium heat (8:06).
  3. Once the oil is hot, carefully drop the patties into the pans (8:40).
  4. Since canned tuna is already cooked, you are just looking for texture (8:52). Fry each side until a deep, beautiful, crunchy golden crust forms (9:34).
  5. Remove from the pans and serve warm! Aaron suggests pairing these savory, salty croquettes with something smooth and creamy, like mashed potatoes (10:45).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 4: Pan-Fry to Perfection
